propositions: docs/releasing.md incorrectly describes the pypi environment's required-reviewers rule as 'second human approval' when it is a single configured identity (JoeOakhartNava) that is both the dispatcher and sole required reviewer, with self-review permitted and admin bypass available

docs/releasing.md and .github/workflows/release.yml describe approval as an interactive human prompt, but the actual mechanism is a non-interactive REST call to the pending_deployments endpoint that must be made with a properly-typed JSON body (environment_ids as integer array, not string flags)

the environment rule provides identity and ref control over who can release the publish job, not independent content review; the 'published source was reviewed' guarantee derives from Gerrit-review on main, which the runbook already documents correctly

the runbook must teach operators both the read operation (GET pending_deployments to discover environment id) and the write operation (POST pending_deployments with typed JSON body containing environment_ids, state, and comment) to approve non-interactively without guessing or mistyping
